feed.title: Tesla said fatal Autopilot crash data didn't exist — a $15K bug bounty hacker proved it did, costing Tesla $243 million
feed.summary: A lawsuit against Tesla resulted in a $243 million payout after a hacker proved the company had access to fatal Autopilot crash data, despite claiming otherwise. feed.title: Delta Air Lines Removes Aircraft From Service At Hartsfield-Jackson As Carrier Nears The Top For Canceled Flights
feed.summary: A Delta Air Lines flight from Hartsfield-Jackson International Airport to Raleigh-Durham was removed from service due to a right-engine mechanical issue, causing significant delays for 173 passengers. This incident contributed to widespread disruptions for Delta, which faced numerous delays and cancellations on Thursday and Friday, largely due to severe weather and FAA ground stops in the Northeast. Delta is currently leading U.S. carriers in flight delays and is among the top three for cancellations, prompting the airline to offer flexible rebooking options for affected Northeast customers.

feed.title: One year after protest, organizers say Microsoft still needs to cut ties with Israeli military
feed.summary: One year after protests, organizers from "No Azure for Apartheid" are still calling for Microsoft to sever all ties with the Israeli military, claiming the company's technology was used for mass surveillance in Gaza. Former Microsoft and Amazon employees, who were arrested during last year's demonstrations, emphasize the importance of continued pressure on tech executives.

feed.title: 3 Things to Know Before You Buy Waste Management Stock
